# LLM provider availability is degradable, budget exhaustion is fatal/resumable

If the LLM provider is unavailable the compile degrades (continues with deterministic facts and emits a warning); if the LLM budget is exhausted (LLMBudgetExceeded) the compile fails with a CompileError indicating a resumable failure.

Treat transient provider unavailability as non-fatal to allow compilation to proceed, but treat exhausted LLM quota as a resumable failure that must be retried after quota is replenished.
